title: Croatian Pork Skillet
description: A flavorful and spicy Mexican dish made with crispy pork, crunchy vegetables, and a hint of Croatian flair.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pork and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the skillet and set aside.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced bell pepper and minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the cumin and chili powder to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the pork to the skillet and stir to coat with the tomato mixture.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the pork is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
